claim: Q80 mixed-1p5-v1 command buffers per decode token fell from 337 to 49 by keeping RMSNorm, DeltaNet conv/recurrent, GQA rope+attn, SwiGLU, residual add, and the shared/combine tail device-resident in the same MTLCommandBuffer as the mixed GEMVs. synchronization (wait−gpu) is a named component: paired-process median 15.864 ms vs 78.684 ms on the host-activation arm and 83.375 ms in the closed G003 ledger. Greedy ids stay [8420, 748, 264, 729, 429, 17431, 288, 264, 914, 320, 72, 1734]. Silent fallbacks remain 0. The remaining split is the 512-logit router readback that binds ten mixed expert payloads.
confidence: HIGH on CB count, greedy identity, silent-fallback zero, and GPU timestamps. MEDIUM on the exact ns still locked behind a bindless mixed expert table (not measured; would need qwen80_device_expert_table.rs, outside this lane).

measurement.label: DIRTY_ENGINEERING
measurement.regime: 3 alternating paired process reps (base = HAWKING_Q80_DEVICE_ACTIVATIONS=0, ours = default device activations + fuse) plus one ours process with 3 generates. Decode-only ns (prefill subtracted). GPU time from completed MTLCommandBuffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime after wait.
measurement.gpu_authority: completed MTLCommandBuffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime after wait; never a CPU-wait proxy
measurement.kernel_runtime_genome: Qwen80MixedHybridDecodeSession recon_fuse=true facet1=true facet2=true device_activations=true collapse_fuse=true; prefix = device RMS + mixed GEMV + device DeltaNet/GQA + residual + post-RMS + shared SwiGLU + router; wait; host top-10; suffix = routed wave + device combine. Fused CB = suffix_i + prefix_{i+1}. 49 CBs / 2834 dispatches per decode token.

synchronization.definition: sum over decode CBs of (wait_ns − gpu_ns) from completed MTLCommandBuffer timestamps; not folded into wall
synchronization.note: 49 CBs remain, so wait−gpu cannot fall to the Qwen38 0.384 ms (1 CB) band. Recovered 62.8 ms vs the paired host-activation arm and 67.5 ms vs G003. The 75–83 ms prize was the 1-CB hypothetical.

topology.breakdown: 1× L0 mixer+prefix, 47× (suffix_i + mixer/prefix_{i+1}), 1× (last suffix + terminal RMS + lm_head)
topology.opt_out: HAWKING_Q80_COLLAPSE_FUSE=0 → 97 CBs (prefix CB + suffix CB + terminal). HAWKING_Q80_DEVICE_ACTIVATIONS=0 → 337 CBs host path.

designed_host_ops_still_present.host_activation: 1344 = 48 layers × 28 forwards; this is host top-10 only, not RMS/DeltaNet/GQA

remaining_cb_split_readbacks.name: router_logits_readback
remaining_cb_split_readbacks.why_it_still_forces_a_split: 512 f32 router logits must return to the host so source_qwen80_topk_router can pick 10 experts and bind their mixed binary/CSR/HGRAVS payloads. A device top-10 does not remove the split: mixed expert buffers are still bound from host-known IDs. A bindless mixed expert table would live in qwen80_device_expert_table.rs, which this lane cannot edit.

remaining_cb_split_readbacks.name: lm_head_logits_readback
remaining_cb_split_readbacks.why_it_still_forces_a_split: Host greedy argmax needs the vocab logit vector after the terminal CB. This is one wait at the end of the token, not a per-layer split. The next token's embed is still a host Q8 row gather, so the sampled id must cross back to the CPU.

gpu_ns_rose_because: GPU timestamps now cover the whole fused CB, including device DeltaNet/GQA/RMS/SwiGLU that G003 counted as host exclusive (43.5 ms host DeltaNet). That is a move from host to GPU, not a GEMV regression. Wall still dropped (paired median 157 ms vs 261 ms).
